name: PCI DSS v4.0
description: Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard — global standard that provides a baseline of technical and operational requirements designed to protect payment account data.

controls.title: Network Security Controls — Processes and mechanisms are defined and understood
controls.description: All security policies and operational procedures that are identified in Requirement 1 are documented, kept up to date, in use, and known to all affected parties.

controls.title: Network access controls are implemented
controls.description: Network security controls (NSCs) are configured and maintained to restrict connections between trusted and untrusted networks and between wireless networks and the cardholder data environment.

controls.title: Network access to and from the cardholder data environment is restricted
controls.description: Inbound and outbound traffic is restricted to that which is necessary for the cardholder data environment, and all other traffic is denied.

controls.title: System components are configured and managed securely
controls.description: System configuration standards are developed and implemented for all system components. All security parameters prevent misuse.

controls.title: Storage of account data is kept to a minimum
controls.description: Data storage amount and retention time is kept to a minimum. Policies, procedures, and processes for data retention and disposal are documented and followed.

controls.title: Primary account number (PAN) is secured wherever it is stored
controls.description: PAN is secured with strong cryptography whenever stored in CHD environments.

controls.title: PAN is protected with strong cryptography during transmission
controls.description: PAN is protected with strong cryptography during transmission over open, public networks.

controls.title: Malicious software (malware) is prevented or detected and addressed
controls.description: All system components are protected from malware via anti-malware software or solutions.

controls.title: Bespoke and custom software are developed securely
controls.description: Software development lifecycle processes and procedures are defined and include secure coding practices.

controls.title: Security vulnerabilities are identified and addressed
controls.description: Security vulnerabilities are identified and managed. All critical patches and security patches are installed within defined timeframes.

controls.title: Access to system components and data is appropriately defined and assigned
controls.description: Access to all system components and data is appropriately defined and assigned to individuals based on their job classification and function.

controls.title: User identification and related accounts are managed throughout the account lifecycle
controls.description: All users are assigned a unique ID before allowing them to access system components or cardholder data.

controls.title: User authentication to system components is managed via an authentication factor policy
controls.description: Strong authentication for users and administrators is established and managed.

controls.title: Multi-factor authentication (MFA) is implemented
controls.description: MFA is implemented to secure access into the cardholder data environment for individuals who access it remotely.

controls.title: Physical access controls manage entry into facilities and systems
controls.description: Physical access controls are in place to restrict access to systems in the cardholder data environment.

controls.title: Audit logs capture user activity and events
controls.description: Audit logs are enabled and active for all system components in the CDE.

controls.title: Audit logs are reviewed to identify anomalies or suspicious activity
controls.description: All audit log files are reviewed at least once daily.

controls.title: External and internal vulnerabilities are regularly identified, prioritized, and addressed
controls.description: Internal and external vulnerability scans are performed quarterly and after significant changes.

controls.title: External and internal penetration testing is regularly performed
controls.description: Penetration testing is performed at least once every 12 months and after significant infrastructure or application upgrades.

controls.title: An information security policy is established, published, maintained, and disseminated
controls.description: An overall information security policy is established, reviewed, and published at least once every 12 months.

controls.title: Risks to the cardholder data environment are formally identified, evaluated, and managed
controls.description: A targeted risk analysis is performed for any requirement designated by PCI DSS as a best practice until a future date.
